physicalNotes: Radius 0.455 +/- 0.018 solar radii from Maciejewski et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 436 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014AcA....64..323M/abstract): 316,544 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.47 +/- 0.07 solar masses from Maciejewski et al. 2014, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of GJ 436 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014AcA....64..323M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3505 +/- 51 K from Maxted et al. 2022, the stellar temperature of GJ 436 b's parameter set from Maxted et al. 2022 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.514...77M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
